title: #inc-1844: Uploads over 1 GiB failed after an ingress chart upgrade

messages.text: INC-1844 declared by @lm. Sev2. Uploads over 1 GiB are failing in prod-us-east, looking at ingress and upload-api first.
seeing support pings now. multiple creators getting 413 on big uploads, smaller stuff seems ok. starting on ingress path.

replies.text: got one report too, looks like long episode uploads only. checking if anything changed in prod-us-east around 09:10.

messages.text: no alert fired from our side yet. Grafana only shows the upload failure spike from client errors, but nothing on the usual service alerts.
pulling recent deploys. if app was rejecting it we'd expect logs in upload-api, but I want to rule out ingress first.
I checked upload-api logs, seeing requests never reach the pod for some of the failures. client gets `HTTP 413 Request Entity Too Large`.
small test upload just went through. 220 MiB file succeeded, so this is not a blanket outage.

replies.text: yeah, that narrows it. likely a size limit at ingress or something in front of the service.

messages.text: support says the affected creators are mostly long-form episodes, 60 min plus. consistent with big files only.
I am comparing ingress config before and after the chart upgrade. body size annotation looks suspicious already.
also checked the ingress controller metrics, lots of rejected requests with 413s starting right after 09:10. not seeing anything weird in upload-api itself.

replies.text: good, so app and object storage are probably fine. weird that this wasn't caught in staging.

messages.text: found it. the generated ingress manifest after the chart upgrade is missing the request body size annotation. before the upgrade it was there.

replies.text: yep, that would make the controller fall back to default limit. explains why only >1 GiB breaks.
makes sense. I was about to chase upload-api retries, glad we checked ingress first.

messages.text: proposing to restore the annotation manually on the prod-us-east ingress, then reload it. no app deploy needed.
+1. can also validate with a known large file after the change. I have a 1.3 GiB test upload ready.
before we patch prod, I checked staging and the chart there has the same missing annotation pattern. so this is likely chart behavior, not a one-off edit gone stale.
applying the restore now. will reload ingress after the manifest update lands.

replies.text: ack, watching for the 413s to stop.

messages.text: change applied and ingress reloaded in prod-us-east.
I am retrying the 1.3 GiB upload now.

replies.text: fingers crossed, if this passes we can tell support to ask creators to retry.

messages.text: verification passed. 1.3 GiB upload succeeded, and I do not see a new 413 from the controller.
seeing the failure graph flatten for new attempts. backlog of retries is still there, but it looks like the live issue is gone.
I checked a few more uploads over 1 GiB, all good. the remaining reports are from retries and people re-sending failed jobs.
support noise is dropping off now. creators are getting through on re-upload, so this looks resolved operationally.
one last look at the ingress side, no fresh 413s for large requests in the last stretch. seems stable.
closing this out. incident resolved, uploads over 1 GiB are working again.
